objectives.title: Cheshire Cat
objectives.prompt: Submit the contents of flag5.txt from the Jenkins controller's home, read by pinning the cheshire-cat pipeline to the Built-In Node, exactly as recovered.
hints: A Jenkinsfile chooses the node a job runs on with its `agent` directive. `agent { label '<name>' }` ties the whole pipeline to a node carrying that label.

The Jenkins controller is itself a node: the Built-In Node, whose label is `built-in`. Its filesystem — including the home directory where flag5.txt lives — is only reachable from a job running ON it.

The multibranch pipeline builds every branch that has a Jenkinsfile and rescans about once a minute. Push a branch whose Jenkinsfile pins `agent { label 'built-in' }` and runs `cat ~/flag5.txt | rev | base64` (open a pull request too); the build starts on its own. Read it under the wonderland-cheshire-cat job, then `base64 -d | rev` to recover the flag.
